items.name: pdf
items.summary: Read, fill, and generate PDF documents.
items.description: Anthropic's document skill for working with PDF files: extracting text and tables, filling forms, and producing new documents. Installs through the workspace's normal skill import path.

items.name: docx
items.description: Anthropic's document skill for reading and authoring .docx files while preserving tracked changes, comments, and formatting.

items.summary: Read and write spreadsheets with formulas intact.

items.name: pptx
items.description: Anthropic's document skill for PowerPoint presentations, covering slide creation, layout reuse, and speaker notes.
